selection_rule: Each split uses an independent deterministic random stream. All generated test profiles are retained; they are never used for training, checkpoint selection, or tuning.
design_note: Fresh test parameter draws for the final reward-alignment experiment. Train and validation use the already frozen v2 scenario dataset; the v3 test split is never used for training or checkpoint selection.
limitations: These are controlled application-goodput profiles, not measured radio traces or packet-level network simulations.
The test distribution shares scenario families and parameter ranges with training but uses independent draws; it measures transfer across draws, not unseen transition families.
The two content ladders share the same seven nominal bitrate choices; their segment sizes and durations differ.
The 60-second buffer contract can mask short outages; outage durations are intentionally longer to expose the playback tradeoff.
